payload.description_html:
Stratigraphic succession of Spion Kop Farm, illustrating the faunal assemblages recovered from the upper Elliot Formation as preserved on the farm.

SQ, ‘Sauropod [Pulanesaura] Quarry’; MQ, ‘Marc’s [Aardonyx] Quarry’. All cartographic information was recorded by JN and reproduced using Inkscape (vers. 0.91). All dinosaur silhouettes were drawn by the authors except for the one next to Arcusaurus, which is licensed under the CC-BY-SA GNU Free Documentation License and is attributed to Arthur Weasley. The original image and use policy for the image is available here: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Thecodontosaurus.jpg.
